definition: A baseline we wrote, not a real product: the same transcript parsing as Clariflow, then 'save as heard' with no checks (first asset candidate, Celsius assumed, spoken hour kept as-is, missing unit left blank, contradictions saved as fact, last value wins, nothing asked). On audio it uses plain verbatim STT.
